newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BOND YIELDS CLOSE LOWER, CURVE STEEPENS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BOND YIELDS CLOSE LOWER, CURVE STEEPENS.

text.p: 1605/1305 GMT - Bond yields fall across the board on
Thursday but the yield curve steepens as buyers focus on short
maturities and shed the long end on EMU jitters, dealers say.
Focus on U.S. May payrolls due on Friday at 1530/1230 GMT.
Markka pares earlier losses as buyers emerge at 3.0050 per mark,
DEM/FIM seen in tight 2.9950-3.0050 range.
*FIM-06 yld pct 6.13 vs 6.18 *06 gap over Bund bps 32 vs 33
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.73 vs 5.77 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.68 vs 3.74
*Jun FRAs 3.09 pct vs 3.08 *March FRAs 3.73 pct vs 3.76
Finnish bonds strengthened with
German Bunds on Thursday with most activity in short maturities,
particularly the 1999 and 2001 papers, dealers said.
International market focus was on U.S. May payrolls due on
Friday at 1530/1230 GMT. The average U.S. May unemployment rate
forecast is 5.0 percent, up from 4.9 percent in April.
The markka fell to around 3.00 per mark as an earlier dip
prompted domestic buying, dealers said. "Domestic players
started buying at 3.0050," one dealer said, adding he saw
similar support for the markka versus the dollar at 5.20.
